name: Defence and attack from 4 or 2
objective: Back-row and front-zone defence, setting and a controlled attack from 4 or from 2 in a continuous rally.
description: Full court, continuous rally, no block and no scoring for now. The waiting line stands outside the court, behind zone 6. You choose the attack zone (4 or 2) and the direction (cross-court or down the line). Attacking from 4: rotating players at 1, 6 and 4 plus a libero at 5; the path is waiting line → 1 → 6 → 4 → attack → waiting line of the other court. Attacking from 2: rotating players at 6, 1 and 2 plus a libero at 5, with zone 4 empty; the path is waiting line → 6 → 1 → 2 → attack → waiting line of the other court. Defensive formation. Attack from 4, cross-court: the front-row player drops to the short diagonal, the player at 5 defends the long diagonal, the player at 6 moves to 6-5 to help and the player at 1 moves to 1-2 to cover a tip behind the block. Attack from 4, down the line: the player at 1 defends the line, the player at 6 moves to 6-1, and the player at 4 moves to 3 to cover a tip behind the block. Attacking from 2 is the same, mirrored.
fixedRoles:
Setter (one per court): starts between 2 and 3, penetrates to set and always looks at 4. Attack from 4: front set. Attack from 2: back set.
Libero (one per court): zone 5.
rotating: 8 players: 3 on court per side and 1 in the waiting line.
sequence:
The coach attacks onto court A from outside court B (only to start the rally).
Everyone starts at the base position of her zone. When the other court sets, the defenders move to the defensive formation.
Whoever the ball goes to digs.
The setter penetrates from between 2 and 3 and sets to the attack zone.
Controlled attack in the chosen direction, no block.
The defenders go back to the base position while their own setter sets.
The same happens on the other court, continuous rally.
rotation:
The attacker changes court outside the net, by the post on her side, and joins the waiting line of the other court.
The other two rotating players move up one spot along the path.
The first player in the waiting line comes in at the entry zone (1 when attacking from 4, 6 when attacking from 2).
If the waiting line is empty, the player arriving from the other court goes straight to the entry zone.

name: Pepper · Traditional
objective: Warm up ball control: attack, dig and set in a continuous 1 vs 1 exchange across the net.
description: Twelve players in six pairs, side by side, one player beside each sideline; the ball travels parallel to the net. Both players take turns attacking, digging and setting. The attack is a controlled hit with no jump, aimed at the partner. No scoring.
fixedRoles: Pairs: A beside one sideline, B beside the other.
sequence:
A attacks to B (controlled hit, no jump).
B digs to A.
A sets to B.
B attacks to A.
A digs to B.
B sets to A and the sequence repeats.
rotation: No rotation: each pair stays in its row.

name: Pepper · 3 consecutive touches
objective: Warm up ball control and the full attack chain: dig, self set and attack, one player at a time.
description: Twelve players in six pairs, side by side, one player beside each sideline; the ball travels parallel to the net. Each player makes three touches in a row (dig, set to self, attack) before the ball goes to the partner. The attack is a controlled hit with no jump. No scoring.
fixedRoles: Pairs: A beside one sideline, B beside the other.
sequence:
A attacks to B (controlled hit, no jump).
B digs, sets to self and attacks to A.
A digs, sets to self and attacks to B.
The sequence repeats.
rotation: No rotation: each pair stays in its row.

name: Pepper · Short (dig and set)
objective: Warm up the attacker and the dig-and-set sequence with fixed roles.
description: Twelve players in six pairs, side by side, one player beside each sideline; the ball travels parallel to the net. A only attacks; B digs and then sets back to A. The attack is a controlled hit with no jump. No scoring.
fixedRoles: Pairs: A beside one sideline, B beside the other.
sequence:
A attacks to B (controlled hit, no jump).
B digs and sets back to A.
A attacks again and the sequence repeats.
rotation: No rotation: each pair stays in its row.

name: Pepper · Traditional with 3 players
objective: Warm up ball control with attack, dig and set, and the movement between sides, in groups of three.
description: Twelve players in four groups of three, one group per row across the court; the ball travels parallel to the net. A and C start by one sideline and B by the other. The player who attacks sets after the dig, then crosses to the other side. The attack is a controlled hit with no jump. No scoring.
fixedRoles: Groups of three (A, B and C): A and C start by one sideline, B by the other.
sequence:
A attacks to B (controlled hit, no jump).
B digs to A.
A sets for B and crosses to the other sideline.
B attacks to C, C digs to B, B sets for C and crosses to the other sideline.
C attacks to A, A digs to C, C sets for A and crosses to the other sideline.
The rotation repeats.
rotation: The player who digs attacks next. After setting, the player crosses to the other sideline and waits behind the active player on the other sideline; whoever waited on the side they left steps up.

name: Pepper · 3 consecutive touches with 3 players
objective: Warm up the full attack chain (dig, self set, attack) and the movement between sides, in groups of three.
description: Twelve players in four groups of three, one group per row across the court; the ball travels parallel to the net. A and C start by one sideline and B by the other. A attacks and crosses to the other side; then each player in turn digs, sets to self, attacks and crosses. The attack is a controlled hit with no jump. No scoring.
fixedRoles: Groups of three (A, B and C): A and C start by one sideline, B by the other.
sequence:
A attacks to B (controlled hit, no jump) and crosses to the other sideline.
B digs, sets to self, attacks to C and crosses to the other sideline.
C digs, sets to self, attacks to A and crosses to the other sideline.
A digs, sets to self, attacks and crosses to the other sideline, and the rotation repeats.
rotation: After attacking, the player crosses to the other sideline and waits behind the active player on the other sideline; whoever waited on the side they left steps up.

name: Ball control · Y
objective: Practise the self dig, the set and the controlled attack in a continuous flow with a waiting line.
description: Players at positions 2 and 4 and a controller at 6, with three more waiting in line behind 6. The player at 4 starts with the ball and makes a controlled hit (no jump) to 6. The controller digs to herself, sets to the other spot and moves there, while a waiting player enters at 6. No scoring.
fixedRoles: Two hitters at 2 and 4, one controller at 6, a waiting line behind 6.
sequence:
The player at 4 hits a controlled ball (no jump) to 6.
The player at 6 digs to herself.
She sets to the player at the other spot (2 or 4) and moves to that spot.
The player who hit leaves to the end of the waiting line.
The next player in line enters at 6 and the sequence repeats, alternating spots.
rotation: Hitter goes to the end of the line, controller takes the spot she set to, first in line enters at 6.
progressions:
Regression: the player who receives the set first sets to herself and then attacks; the player who set goes straight to that spot and stands behind the attacker.
Progression: after the self set she tips (finta) to the player who just set, who stands close to her; that player digs the tip up and the attack continues to the new player coming in at 6.

name: Ball control · X
objective: Practise the high dig, the set and the controlled attack with movement between back and front spots.
description: Four spots on one court: 1 and 5 at the back, 2 and 4 at the front, with a waiting line of three. The ball is attacked from the front to the back, dug high to the centre, set to the next front spot and attacked again, alternating sides. No scoring.
fixedRoles: Players at the four spots (1, 5, 2, 4) and a waiting line of three.
sequence:
A player at the front makes a controlled attack (no jump) to a back spot.
The back player digs high to the centre.
The player at the other back spot moves to the centre and sets to the next front spot, then moves there.
The sequence repeats, alternating sides, and a new player fills the spot that was vacated.
rotation: The setter takes the front spot she set to; a player from the line fills the back spot.
progressions:
Regression: the player who receives the set first sets to herself and then attacks; the player who set goes straight to that spot and stands behind the attacker.
Progression: after the self set she tips (finta) to the player who just set, who stands close to her; that player digs the tip up and the attack continues to the new player coming in at the back spot.

name: Chaos
objective: Practise finger touches and fast transitions, with a continuous flow of players on both courts.
description: Four players on each court and two waiting at the side of each court. The coach throws a free ball to one court. Each side makes three touches and sends the ball over the net, and the touches depend on the variation. After every touch, that player goes to touch the cone at the side and joins the waiting line, and a waiting player takes the place. No scoring.
fixedRoles: 4 players per court, 2 waiting at the side of each court, a coach.
sequence:
The coach throws a free ball to court A.
Each side makes 3 touches and sends the ball over the net.
After every touch, the player goes to touch the cone and joins the waiting line.
A waiting player immediately takes the vacated spot.
The ball keeps going from side to side.
rotation: After each touch the player goes to the cone and to the end of the waiting line; the first waiting player takes the spot.
progressions:
Forearm only: the three touches are forearm passes.
Forearm, finger and tip: dig, finger set, and a tip over the net.
Forearm, finger and spike: dig, finger set and a spike.

name: Side-out circuit
objective: Practise serve, receive, set and attack in a circuit where the sides alternate.
description: Two groups work at the same time, one on each half of the court. On each half, the servers are at zone 1: the one who serves or throws stands inside the court and the others wait behind the end line. She sends the ball to zone 5 of the opposite court, where a player receives and then attacks, and one more player waits behind zone 5 to come in. A fixed setter on each half sets. Players rotate 5A → 1B → 5B → 1A. No scoring.
fixedRoles: Per half: the servers at zone 1 (the first one inside the court), a receiver and attacker at zone 5 with one player waiting behind her, and a fixed setter. Two setters in total.
sequence:
The first server at zone 1 serves or throws from inside the court to zone 5 of the opposite court.
The player at 5 receives with a forearm pass to the setter.
The setter sets to zone 4.
The receiver attacks the set, and the player waiting behind zone 5 comes in to receive the next ball.
The attacker goes to the end of the line at zone 1 on the other side; the server goes to wait behind zone 5 on her own side.
rotation: Rotation 5A → 1B → 5B → 1A: the attacker goes to the line at 1 on the opposite side; the server goes to wait behind 5 on her own side of the court and comes in when the receiver goes to attack.
progressions:
Serve: two-hand bounce throw; spike to the floor; float serve; spin serve; jump serve.
Attack: no jump; jump and catch at the highest point; jump and tip.
